Hello Rho Agenda fans.  I’m back from Hawaii and it’s been a busy last several weeks with a multitude of interviews across the country.   Saturday night, Aug 29, I had the privilege  of sitting down for a three hour interview with Ian Punnett on Coast To Coast AM for a rowdy and very entertaining interview.   As is his norm, Ian pressed me repeatedly on the exact nature of my work at Los Alamos National Laboratory and Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory, how much of the technologies there might be based upon technologies actually reverse engineered from an alien craft the government may have in its possession, which technologies in my best selling Rho Agenda series are on the verge of being released to the public, etc.  While classification level prevented me from answering each and every one of his questions, the interchange led to a full hour of listener call-ins and a lively show.  I invite all of you to listen for yourselves through the following link:

http://www.coasttocoastam.com/show/2009/08/29

Thanks to the fine folks at Coast To Coast AM for their effort in setting this up.
